Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Arun Dev Choudhury
 Order
07.04.2025
1.
Heard Mr. S. Borthakur, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Ms. P. R. Mahanta, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue Department for the respondent No. 1, Mr. B. Choudhury, learned Standing Counsel, PWD for the respondent Nos. 2 and 3 and Ms. K. Konwar, learned Junior Government Advocate, Assam, for the respondent Nos. 4, 5 and 6.
2.

The petitioner's grievance is that a part of the petitioner's land has been acquired for the purpose of construction of a Flyover at Zoo Road, Guwahati but the compensation amount determined in respect of such acquisition of land has not yet been disbursed to the petitioner.

3. Referring to the notice dated 26.05.2023, Mr. Borthakur, learned counsel for the petitioner claims that though it is shown to be a notice under Section 7(1) of the Assam Land (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1964 (hereinafter referred to as Act, 1964), however, the said notice shows that the amount had already been Page No.# 3/4 determined (Rs.78,13,400.46/-) in favour of the petitioner,
whose land was acquired.
4. It is the specific stand of the petitioner that no other notice whatsoever, has been received by the petitioner prior such notice dated 26.05.2023.

5. When this Court sought for instruction, the learned counsel representing the Deputy Commissioner, has forwarded curtain instruction which goes to show that an award was passed in LA Case No. 13/2022 and in terms of the said award, a portion of land measuring 12 lechas of land covered by Dag No. 2458 (Kha) of K.P. Patta No. 1501 under Revenue Village- No. 2 Japorigog,
Mouza- Beltola under Dispur Revenue Circle has been acquired for construction of fly over at Zoo Nayanmani Deka vs The State Of Assam And 5 Ors on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102535705/
2 road Tiniali as per provision of the Act, 1964.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, the notice under Section 7(1) of the Act,
1964 was issued to the concerned pattadar of the aforesaid Dag number, namely, one Madhab Goswami son of Baladev, the petitioner and one M/s Build Wall Assam Pvt. Limited for receiving land acquisition compensation.

6. Thereafter, the Circle Officer, Dispur Revenue Circle was asked to submit a report, after spot verification so that payment can be released to the actual owner of the land as there are two other co-pattadars and accordingly, the Circle Officer has submitted a report stating that handhold Chitha copy of Dispur Revnue Circle, name of the petitioner was recorded as pattadar in respect of Dag No.
2458 of KP Patta No. 1501 and as per Dharitri Portal, the Dag No. is recorded as 2458 of KP Patta No. 1601 and for such discrepancy, the Dispur Revenue Circle has asked to submit a fresh report asking actual possession and accordingly, the petitioner was also asked to submit NOC from co-pattadars i.e. Madhab Goswami as well as M/s Build Wall Assam Pvt. Limited.
7. Issue notice returnable after four weeks.
Page No.# 4/4 8.
As all the respondents are duly represented through their respective counsels, no formal notice need be issued to the said respondents.
9. Let an affidavit be filed by the District Commissioner.
10. In the affidavit, the District Commissioner shall clarify the position, whether any award has been passed in LA Case No. 13/2022 and if so, the award shall also be produced before this Court.

11. The District Commissioner also produced the record of LA Case No. 13/2022 and clarify the position under what provision of law, the Circle Officer was directed to carry out a fresh enquiry and whether there is any objection from any co-pattadars in the land acquisition process.

12. List this matter after four weeks on a date to be fixed by the Registry.
